name: com.netacom.full.extensions.SmsBroadcastReceiver
description: This NetAlo Chat SDK receiver handles Google's SMS Retriever result for one-time-code login. It can pass the text-message consent prompt to the login screen or report a retrieval timeout; the analyzed release does not activate it during normal login.
disableEffect: Disabling it has no user-visible effect in the analyzed release because this receiver is not activated.
